fit_set.method: sha256 over sorted(basename + bytes) of the SERVED posterior_summary_*.json files (not_served stems excluded; n_arms counts the same files)

unfitted_note: models without a posterior fit in the served pool wave or the landed interim models: absent under the Bayesian source, named in the readout

fit_frame.note: served pool fits stand on the wave's own task frame; interim models on the candidate wave's

interim.rule: landed models of the candidate wave drawn as interim (difficulty 2026-09-03 ~16:1xZ); the served pre-§1b rows remain only for models not yet landed; two waves = two fitted axes, disclosed per model

gates.convention: FAIL iff divergences/(chains×samples) > 0.5% or R-hat gate not pass or ESS gate FAIL (bayes-refits DATA-CONTRACTS)
gates.line: sampler gate (0.5%-of-draws convention): 8 of 12 pass · max divergence share 0.00% · R-hat ≤ 1.012 · bulk-ESS ≥ 272

provisional_classes.status: provisional; results re-enter at the next cut after the judged verdicts are refreshed
provisional until the twin draws are re-bound

pool_cells_undercredit.disclosure: the ruling of 7 Sep 20:5x: the composed valid-cells file is the source for a wave 2 cell's attempts and passes (bound through the intake, default flipped 21:37, sha 390f58e212c1; composed cells from the 22:07 pass); the frames these waves were cut from ignored the continuation and redraw legs of arms whose answers were cut at a cap, so those arms' wave 2 cells under-credit passes; waves cut before the 5 Sep collapse of the Claude legs also carried the continuation leg as a second 128-attempt shard of failures

estimand_note: two chains: MEDIAN-TASK (d50/d1, kde ridges, `levels` = exact crossing draws) and AVERAGE-RATE (`levels_avg` = band-inverted from the fit's pointwise average-rate quantile curves; interim estimator)
definition_of_record: reliability = the average-rate 1% crossing (difficulty, Definitions ledger 2026-09-04); fitting's exact levels tables = the median-task crossing
